label: Core advantage: technically differentiated AI/software product > generic education-content/marketing offering.
Product leverage: scalable AI/software automation > labor-intensive human service.
Execution style: rapid MVP, measurement and iteration > long closed-door polished build.
Decision process: data/logic/experiments > intuition-only product decisions.
Resource strategy: high efficiency and deliberate resource allocation > wasteful feature/team expansion without evidence.
Collaboration style: team input and cross-functional discussion > founder-only decision-making.
Family/time constraint: protect weekends/family time where possible > always-on founder schedule.
Product quality: quality/brand credibility > lowest-cost product positioning.
